<!-- pr-reviewer: 55d40c618b1c47ebdbcfb64e713a1f44305c91c8 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- The diff is comment-only: one Gate map line in each of `crates/app/tests/grblhal_post.rs` and `crates/app/tests/tinyg_post.rs` (`app::post` becomes `camcraft_post::post`, `post::machine` becomes `camcraft_post::machine`). No code, no process files, no dependencies, no snapshots.
- `crates/post/src/post/` and `crates/post/src/machine/` exist, so both names are real module paths. `camcraft_app::post` is a re-export of `camcraft_post::post` (`crates/app/src/lib.rs:49`).
- Quick-gate map reader (`xtask/src/quick.rs` `map_modules`): for a src change in another crate it matches `\b(camcraft_)?<crate>::<module>\b`, so `camcraft_post::post` and `camcraft_post::machine` are what it expects. Checked with `cargo xtask gate quick --dry-run` on scratch edits in the trial merge:
  - a change in `crates/post/src/machine/` selects `app:grblhal_post` and `app:tinyg_post` (gate map names post::machine);
  - a change in `crates/post/src/post/engine.rs` selects the post crate's own `script_grblhal` and `script_tinyg`. Because a submodule-specific map exists, only those are chosen, and the app suites are chosen for other post-module files.
- The suites rightly stay in `crates/app/tests`: they import `camcraft_app::machine::parse_mch` and `camcraft_app::posting::{BUILTINS, MACHINES}`, which `crates/app/src` defines.

**Local results (merged with current origin/main; only xtask built)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| merge with origin/main | already up to date, no conflicts |
| `cargo test -p xtask` | 91 passed, 0 failed (includes `gate_maps_tests::no_gate_map_names_a_moved_module_as_app`) |
| `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

The two app suites were not run; the change touches only comments.

**Requested before merge**: none.

**Notes (not blocking)**: the two edited header lines run slightly past the usual wrap width; harmless.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
